ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Care for PRACTICES be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

3. A — newton (N)

4. C — Glucose and oxygen

5. D — 100 °C

7. A — Producers

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

9. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

10. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
